data.name: Brigitta
data.gender_notes: Brigitta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Brigitta is derived from the Latin word 'brigittas', meaning 'exalted one', 'strong one', or 'powerful one'. In Christian tradition, Saint Brigitta is a 4th-century Irish nun and abbess, known for her piety, prophecies, and miracles. The name Brigitta carries the meaning “Exalted one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Brigitta usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Brigitta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brigitta total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: בריגיטה
in_hebrew.meaning: השם בריגיטה נגזר משם הקלטי בריגיד, שמשמעותו כוח או מרץ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בריגיטה מקורו בשם הקלטי בריגיד, הנגזר מהמילה הקלטית 'בריג', שמשמעותו כוח או מרץ. השם בריגיד היה קשור לאלה הקלטית של האש, המשירה והשירה. הנוצרים אימצו את השם והעניקו לו משמעות רוחנית, הקשורה לכוח ולמרץ הרוחניים. השם בריגיטה הוא גרסה נשית של השם בריגיד, והוא משמש כסמל לכוח ולעוצמה הנשית

in_greek.name: Μπριγκίτα
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Μπριγκίτα προέρχεται από το Κελτικό όνομα Μπριγκίδ, που σημαίνει δύναμη ή ζωντάνια
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπριγκίτα έχει τις ρίζες του στο Κελτικό όνομα Μπριγκίδ, το οποίο προέρχεται από τη λέξη 'Μπριγκ', που σημαίνει δύναμη ή ζωντάνια. Στην κελτική μυθολογία, η Μπριγκίδ ήταν η θεά της φωτιάς, της ποίησης και του τραγουδιού. Οι Χριστιανοί υιοθέτησαν το όνομα και του έδωσαν μια πνευματική σημασία, που συνδέεται με τη δύναμη και τη ζωντάνια του πνεύματος. Το όνομα Μπριγκίτα είναι η γυναικεία μορφή του ονόματος Μπριγκίδ και αποτελεί σύμβολο της θηλυκής δύναμης και της πνευματικής ενέργειας

in_latin.name: Brigitta
in_latin.meaning: The name Brigitta means strength or vitality, derived from Celtic roots
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Brigitta originates from the Celtic name Brigid, which comes from the Celtic word 'brig', meaning strength or vitality. In Celtic mythology, Brigid was the goddess of fire, poetry, and song. Christians adopted the name and gave it a spiritual significance, connected to the strength and vitality of the spirit. The name Brigitta is the feminine form of Brigid, symbolizing feminine power and spiritual energy

in_english.name: Brigitta
in_english.meaning: Brigitta means exalted one, strong, or virtuous in Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Brigitta is derived from the Celtic name Brigid, which means exalted one, strong, or virtuous. It originated from the Celtic word 'brig', signifying strength, power, or virtue. In Christian tradition, Brigitta is associated with Saint Brigid of Kildare, a 5th-century Irish saint known for her piety, compassion, and strength. The name symbolizes spiritual strength, courage, and devotion, reflecting the values of Christian faith and tradition

data.cultural_impact: Saint Brigitta is a revered figure in Irish and Christian history. She is the only Irish female saint whose feast day (February 1) is a Holy Day of Obligation in Ireland. Her monastery, established in Kildare, Ireland, is still an active site of pilgrimage, attracting thousands of visitors every year. The story of Saint Brigitta and her monastic community has been a source of inspiration for Irish writers, poets, and artists throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: Saint Brigitta is remembered for her intense spirituality, devotion, and prophetic gifts. Legend has it that she was granted the gift of prophecy by God, enabling her to foresee future events. She is also believed to have founded the Bridgetine Order, which emphasizes prayer, fasting, and manual labor. Her life and teachings continue to inspire and guide Christians, as they strive to follow God's will and live lives filled with love, faith, and unwavering devotion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Brigitta, derived from Brigid, is a name rooted in Celtic mythology. It symbolizes creativity, healing, and sacred dedication. As a Christian saint, Brigitta personifies the spiritual power of nurturing and transformation.

historical_references.reference: Saint Brigitta of Sweden, also known as Saint Birgitta, was a Swedish saint and visionary. She was born around 1303 in Björklinge, Sweden.
historical_references.context: Brigitta was the founder of the Brigittine Order, a Catholic religious order for women, and is considered a patron saint of Sweden.

trends: Brigitta is a popular name in Scandinavia, especially in Sweden and Norway
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Brigitta remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Brigitta, a minister in London, United Kingdom, shares that their name Brigitta meaning "Exalted one" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
